sys.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for may have moved or been removed.

languageHint.body: This page is also available in English.

consent.title: Cookies
consent.body: We use cookies to improve the site and to measure how our ads perform. You can change your choice at any time.

thankYou.title: Thank you
thankYou.body: We have your request. Our team will get back to you shortly.

forms.hire: We have your worker request; we will line up suitable candidates and come back to you.
forms.contact: We have your message and usually reply within one business day.
forms.partner: We have your partnership enquiry; our business development team will be in touch.
forms.careers: We have your application; we will contact you when a suitable role opens.
forms.newsletter: You are on the list; check your inbox to confirm.
forms.callback: We have your callback request; our team will call you back shortly.
forms.visit: Your visit request is noted; we will be in touch to agree a time.
forms.calculator: Your cost estimate is on its way; we will send it over shortly.
forms.fraud: Thank you for the report; we investigate every one.
forms.workers: We have your request for candidates; we will send you matching profiles.

placeholders.name: Your full name
placeholders.message: Tell us briefly what you need
placeholders.subject: What is your message about?
placeholders.description: Who, when, what did they ask for? Every detail helps.
placeholders.licence: e.g. licence number and issuing body
placeholders.coverLetter: Why this role? A few lines are enough.

hints.evidence: JPEG, PNG, WEBP or PDF; up to 8 MB each, three files at most.
hints.linkedinUrl: Optional; a link starting with https://.

errors.phone: Enter a valid phone number (at least 8 digits).
errors.url: Enter a valid link (starting with https://).
errors.file: The file was not accepted; check its type and size.
errors.consent: You need to accept the privacy notice to continue.
errors.captcha: The security check could not be completed. Please try again.

consent.label: I agree to the processing of my personal data as described in the <link>privacy notice</link>.
consent.notice: By sending this form you agree to the processing of your personal data as described in the <link>privacy notice</link>.

captcha.title: The security check did not go through
captcha.body: You can send the form once more, or message us what you typed directly on WhatsApp.

off.title: This form is currently closed
off.body: You can reach us on WhatsApp, by phone or by e-mail; our team replies the same day.

tripped.title: The form is paused for a short while
tripped.body: We have paused the form briefly because of heavy traffic. Send what you typed to us on WhatsApp in one tap.

unauthorized.title: The form cannot accept submissions right now
unauthorized.body: We have told our team. In the meantime, reach us on WhatsApp or by phone.

unavailable.title: Your request could not be sent
unavailable.body: A connection problem stopped your form from reaching us. Please try again, or send what you typed on WhatsApp.

failed.title: Your request could not be processed
failed.body: Your request reached us but could not be processed. Our team will look into it; you can also message us on WhatsApp.

invalid.title: The form could not be sent
invalid.body: Some of the fields were not accepted. Please check what you entered and try again, or message us on WhatsApp.

fallback.whatsappIntro: Hello JobsAdmire, I could not send the form on your website. My details:
